name: kensho-kaku
description: Read-only MCP server exposing the kensho Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes dataset from ken-kaku.com (additional source for Kensho sweepstakes collection). Ken-Kaku.com is a sweepstakes collector that feeds into the main Kensho data pipeline.

input.title: Input schema for kensho-kaku
input.description: kensho-kaku is a read-only MCP server. It requires no input parameters — start it and connect an MCP client to discover its tools. All data is bundled locally; no network, no API key, no account.

output.title: Output schema of kensho-kaku
output.description: kensho-kaku exposes a Streamable HTTP MCP server on the Apify standby container. It produces no dataset or key-value store output; its result is the MCP tool interface itself. Connect an MCP client to the standby URL and call sweepstakes tools.
